The pedestal/column mark 'C1' at every grid point happens to share its literal string with the grid point 'C1' (row C, column 1) — a coincidental naming overlap printed on the drawing, not a data error. Read element_id 'C1' (element_type column) and grid_ref 'C1' (row C x col 1) as unrelated.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'footing_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 5 footing-family elements.
